recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for the core reconciliation. If future DeviceUsage corrections are needed, handle them in the OO Incubator source/publication path rather than by editing the inactive core source/deviceusage directory. Ignore stale checked-in DeviceUsage diagrams or legacy files unless DeviceUsage is reactivated in source/fhir.ini.
issue_request: FHIR-26308 is an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R5 DeviceUseStatement/DeviceUsage. It asked the work group to validate implicit pre-applied changes made while resolving FHIR-14142, FHIR-24680, FHIR-20913, and FHIR-24936, including usageStatus, usageReason, dateAsserted, category, CodeableReference device/reason/body-site handling, and the absence of statusReason. Jira resolved it as accepting the pre-applied changes.
initial_application: No commit subject directly names FHIR-26308, but February 2020 DeviceUseStatement spreadsheet history includes commits whose patch context says "Preapplied FHIR-26308" and shows the accepted element updates being introduced. The retained source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml still carries those accepted shapes and descriptions.
additional_context: Later issues changed the artifact around the accepted baseline: FHIR-31478 renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage, FHIR-32829 added the adherence backbone related to usage status/reason semantics, and FHIR-53203 moved OO body-site content toward bodyStructure CodeableReference. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed DeviceUsage and other OO resources from active core fhir.ini resource/build lists and changed core DeviceUsage links to the OO Incubator IG. A package check of the OO Incubator continuous build found DeviceUsage with the accepted/later element shape.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The commit is an empty external-repo audit because DeviceUsage is outside the current FHIR core build scope; editing the inactive source/deviceusage files would not affect the current core specification.
